Dark Eyes: Super Soldier 2 returns to the Dark Eyes universe, continuing the story of the Super Soldier and his fight for humanity's survival.

After the events of the first game, the war is far from over. The Dark Eyes — known as the Delma — have returned, stronger and more dangerous than ever. Standing above them is the Alpha, an elite Dark Eyes commander whose presence threatens the future of Earth itself.

But the enemy isn't the only battle ahead.

The Super Soldier continues to struggle with the consequences of the Super Soldier Program. Due to the unusually high concentration of Delma blood flowing through his body, he remains caught between human and something else. Because of his condition, he is forced to serve within a secretive division of the Earth Space Defense Force: Shadow Force, the ESDF's classified special operations unit.

As war spreads across the battlefield, hidden truths, dangerous missions, and inner conflicts begin to surface. The fight against the Delma becomes more personal than ever.

Fast-paced and chaotic combat

Fight through intense missions filled with overwhelming enemy forces and large-scale battles alongside the ESDF army.

Experience a mix of gameplay styles:

  • Fast and brutal combat encounters against massive enemy groups

  • Large-scale battlefield missions alongside allied troops

  • Optional stealth sections for tactical approaches

  • Platforming and environmental challenges involving lasers, hazards, and traversal sequences

Customize your combat style with a massive arsenal:

  • Pistols

  • Assault rifles

  • Shotguns

  • Grenade launchers

  • Silenced weapons

  • Experimental prototypes

  • Captured Delma weaponry

Unlock powerful abilities and suit technology:

  • Boost packs

  • Automatic laser cannons

  • Energy shields

  • Rocket packs

Use tactical equipment:

  • Explosive grenades

  • EMP grenades

  • Smoke grenades

Upgrade your weapons, suit systems, and abilities to create a build that matches your playstyle. Invest in speed, firepower, defense, stealth, or advanced technology and shape your own Super Soldier.

Fight the Delma. Face the Alpha. Confront what the Super Soldier Program turned you into.

Auto Battling, Loot Hunting and Idle Progression

Dark Ruins: Nine Dragons Pulling the Coffin combines automatic combat, loot hunting and idle progression. Arrange your team and let your heroes face the hordes. Idle and offline rewards provide resources for their next upgrades.

Combine Gear and Shape Your Builds

Mix class skills, equipment affixes, relics and potions to create builds around poison, burning, freezing, lightning, summons, counterattacks, shields, ricochets or low-health bursts. Adapt your setup around key drops to give heroes different ways to fight.

Four Heroes Up Front, Reserves in Relay

Up to four heroes fight at once. Reserves take over when frontline heroes fall. Equip your main team and reserves, arrange their deployment order and keep your expedition moving.

Collect genes to raise heroes, learn skills and use growth potions. Invest in talents to improve combat power, roster capacity and loot income.

Current Content

  • 13 classes and 78 primary class skills, with 312 skill and branch options in total.
  • 45 primary neutral skills and 27 talent and research nodes.
  • 495 equipment templates covering weapons, offhands and armor, including different level variants.
  • Over 80 ordinary affix categories and 82 mythic affixes.
  • 261 relics, including 40 mythic relics.
  • 99 gene seeds, 22 combat potions and 50 growth potions.
  • 9 progression regions with 20 waves each, plus Boss Rush and endgame challenges.

Forge Mythic Equipment

Upgrade legendary equipment to mythic quality. Reforge mythic affixes by choosing one of three options, then complete your builds with mythic relics earned from endgame challenges.

New Challenges Across Cycles

  • Cycle 1: Raise heroes, collect gear and relics, and build your relay team.
  • Cycle 2: Map modifiers introduce new battle conditions. The forging system also unlocks.
  • Cycle 3: Start earning Mythic Stones through regular progression for mythic upgrades and reforging.
  • Cycle 4: Unlock Boss Rush and face dense boss formations.
  • Cycle 5: Unlock the endgame boss challenge and earn mythic relics.
  • Cycle 6 and beyond: Face more map modifiers, stronger enemies and higher-tier endgame bosses while pursuing higher-tier affixes.

Convenience Features

  • Leaderboards: View other players' progression and hero builds.
  • Smart Assistant: Configure help with hero development, equipment and skill selection, and loot management.
  • Loot Filters: Filter drops by quality, level and other criteria to reduce sorting.
  • Hero Lock: Protect heroes you want to keep from automatic dismissal by the assistant.
  • Weapon Preferences: Set each hero's weapon preference so the assistant's equipment choices better suit your build.

And more small features to discover.

Collect Tradable Badges

Collect in-game badges of different rarities as you play. Equip them to grant bonuses to all allied units. Badges can be traded on Steam and sold on the Steam Community Market.

Build your collection at your own pace, try different combinations, and enjoy relaxed progression.

Free Build, Infinite Possibilities

Equip unique skill runes and freely combine active abilities with support effects. Grow through a simple yet distinctive talent system, and craft your unique combat style by pairing skill runes with talents. Will you become a berserk warrior or a mysterious warlock? The choice is yours.

Rune Words, Legendary Forging

Collect ancient runes and inlay them into base gear following mystical combinations to activate powerful Rune Word effects. Each crafted item brings transformative upgrades, from basic stats to special affixes, forging your ultimate endgame gear.

Ultimate Loot, Thrilling Combat

Challenge randomly generated dark dungeons, face hordes of monsters, and battle elite bosses with deadly threats. Diverse loot drops await, from common whites to rare uniques—every fight could yield a game-changing core item.

Fast-Paced Combat, Strategy & Skill

A fluid ARPG combat system blends movement skills and precise positioning, making every battle exhilarating yet tactical. Boss fights feature intricate designs, multi-phase transformations, and unique mechanics to test your build and reflexes.

"Dark Side Void" is a game where you control mechs to fight against various enemies. In a 2D side-scrolling environment, shooting and melee combat will bring a different experience.

High-Speed ​​Combat

Experience high-speed maneuvering combat in a space environment; skillful maneuvering will create advantageous situations in battle.

A variety of mechs and equipment

Players can freely combine various weapons and equipment, and train different pilots. Players can equip various mechs to challenge different missions.

Various Enemy Types

The game features a variety of dangerous enemies, numerous in number, massive in size, and possessing powerful firepower, posing a challenge to the pilot.

Fight against endless hordes of monsters and survive as long as possible.

Dark Sorcery is a top-down, dark fantasy roguelite where you control a powerful sorcerer in fast-paced battles against overwhelming enemy waves. Level up during each run, expand your abilities, and build increasingly powerful combinations to endure until the end.

Time-based challenge where survival depends on movement, positioning, and progression choices. Enemies grow stronger over time, forcing you to adapt your build and make efficient decisions under pressure.

Features

  • Survival-based gameplay
    Face continuous waves of enemies in time-limited stages.

  • Progressive builds
    Gain levels during each run and choose upgrades to shape your abilities.

  • Active abilities
    Use manual skills such as teleport and dodge to reposition and avoid damage.

  • Dark fantasy setting
    Anime-inspired visuals with a somber and atmospheric tone.

  • Replayable runs
    Each session offers different upgrade paths and combinations.

Dark Thoughts is a bullet heaven about fighting the literal dark thoughts inside your head. You pick a damaged hero, wield their trauma as their weapon and ability, and take an arsenal into a domain of dread; apathy, grief, anger, hate, shame, fear. They all await. Survive long enough and you'll be forced to face the heavy hitters of trauma head-on.

  • DJ Introverto: Never leaves his fortress. Crippling anxiety will do that to you.

  • Sr. Shitposter: Spent years radicalizing senior citizens online and his family at home. All he’s got to show for it is panic attacks.

  • PorkiPanda the Influencer: A pathological liar. But it’s a feature not a bug. It pays off in spades as a slimy Influencer.

  • Kar Krash Karen: was rear-ended into a rage disorder at a red light and ever since has been in suburban samurai training thanks to tutorials online.

  • Danny Doomscroller: his dad let him get online way too young, now he spreads conspiracies in Discord all day. But finally those FPS skills can shine!

  • Psycho L. Bin: she’s a hallucinogenic enthusiast that has acquired devastating mental abilities but they came at a cost.

  • Stikipanda: He’s driven by the rage that consumes him, with a brother like Porki it’s not a surprise he’s unhinged.

  • Short King: aka Li’l Sane is Karen’s offspring and protege, his blade isn’t as long but his bitterness makes it cut very deep.

  • Sin Bin: like her twin sister she is also mentally gifted but she earned her powers the old school way she signed a deal with the Devil.

  • NYX91: is the updated Technomancer model and is built for this. But it also records every kill and is coded to analyze them incessantly.

  • SE7EN11: was replaced by the updated Technomancer model and was left out to pasture, now its devotion goes unnoticed and outbursts are frequent.

  • Plaxico: is a dyslexic subterranean hellhound that loves to hunt but gets bored easily.

Each map is a mental battlefield, with a host of hostiles and with dark thoughts flying from all directions you’ll be hard pressed to complete each map’s duration.

  • Apathetica: the land of apathy, doze off at your own discretion as that’s when the dark thoughts make their move.

  • Gala of Grief: where dreams go to die as evident by the sea of decay. Death patrols this land with laser focus.

  • Ragebait Ridge: the place you go to deal with loss. You can rage all you want, it’s never coming back.

  • Loathe Land: not the place you want to reside as hate is everywhere and loathing isn’t good for the skin.

  • The Hole In My Heart: heartbreak is never easy, it takes time to heal and you need to evolve to move forward.

  • Shame Spiral Street: a rundown pocket of the city that is beyond shameful.

  • Fearmonger Farm: if you get dropped off here you’ll be eating crow. But don’t be afraid, they’ll eat you too.

  • Voices In Your Head: they sit up there and judge you, tear you down but all you need to do is stand strong.

  • Dystopia: the hardest map is also the most inevitable one, our downfall is your downfall.

Each hero comes equipped with afflictions that turn into a weapon and ability when on the battlefield. Leveraging their afflictions to battle the mental anguish is how you take control and evolve. Max out their afflictions and they’ll evolve into a powerful God-like combo. But how your Heroes progress is up to you, you make the choices in the end so it’s all on you.

Every run you’ll find both sanity and happiness. Sanity will keep you alive but happiness is deeper than that. You need to collect happiness and then administer it between runs. Applying happiness to your Mental Health is imperative to your long-term success. Keep an eye on your Case File to ensure you’re progressing positively and with over 100+ accolades to keep you chasing your therapist’s adoration.

Alongside the game Dark Thoughts there’s also a full-length 15 track album by the creator, Pastor Fussycat. Pastor is a long-time music producer and has been releasing music for many years. For Dark Thoughts he went back into his discography and remixed his best mentally-anguished songs specifically for this game. He then crafted a new lead track to spearhead the album appropriately titled Dark Thoughts.

But, the only way to unlock the entire album for download for free?

Complete all 10 maps in the game.

is an atmospheric 2.5D first person action roguelike where dark fantasy and cosmic horror collide with fast, deliberate combat.

Push forward through a decaying world, survive relentless encounters, choose your path at every fork, and shape each run through skills, elemental powers and strange events. Every decision can strengthen your build, corrupt it, or completely change the path ahead.

A New Vision of Retro

Darkest Path combines old school fantasy sprites and retro inspired visuals with modern lighting, volumetric fog, dynamic environments and atmospheric effects.

The result is a world that feels familiar but wrong, filled with strange creatures, forgotten gods and places that should no longer exist.

Key Features

Visceral 2.5D Combat
Every hit matters. Time your attacks, defend yourself, react to enemy pressure and build around increasingly powerful skills and elemental effects.

Choose Your Path
Every level pushes you forward toward new encounters and decisions. At branching paths, choose between events such as the Blood Altar, Gambler, Corruptor, Refiner and more, each capable of changing your run.

Build Your Own Playstyle
Combine active and passive skills with elemental masteries such as Fire, Blood, Holy and Lightning. Discover synergies and turn each run into a different build.

Risk and Reward
Power rarely comes without a price. Sacrifice health, corrupt abilities, gamble resources and make choices that can either save a run or destroy it.

Strange Encounters
Meet mysterious characters and creatures throughout the world. Their stories, choices and consequences reveal pieces of a much larger mystery.

Die, Learn, Return Stronger
Unlock permanent progression, experiment with new combinations and use what you learned to push further into the Darkest Path.

Dark Reaper is a dark-action roguelike that blends gothic aesthetics, the exhilarating horde-slaying thrill of survivor-style games, and deep loot-driven progression.

Become a Reaper wandering the Abyss of Bleached Bones. Venture alone into a desolate land cursed by darkness and confront endless tides of monstrous undead. Struggle to survive amid enemy hordes at first, then evolve your skills and acquire ever more powerful gear until you can sweep away entire armies with a single gesture—experiencing the ultimate thrill of growing from weak to unstoppable.

The game features three classes—Barbarian, Mage, and Assassin. Each class has five skill paths: Physical, Fire, Frost, Lightning, and Poison. Every skill offers multiple mechanical branches: make a Ground-Splitting Strike trigger bleeding chain shockwaves, turn Whirlwind into a sprawling field of lava, or leave an everlasting frozen trail along your Charge path. Every level-up can fundamentally transform the feel of combat.

More than a hundred pieces of equipment with unique legendary powers await discovery. Some completely reshape your skills, while others trigger deeper mechanics such as death chains, blood-sacrifice damage boosts, and shattering ice shells. Combined with random magical affixes, they give rise to dozens of distinct build archetypes, including combo-burst, sustained face-tanking, and high-speed farming. Every unique item drop could unlock an entirely new way to play.

Darkness knows no end, and neither does growth. Take up your weapon, reap loot and glory amid mountains of corpses and seas of blood, and become the most terrifying presence in this abyss.

At the Hexencafé on Lake Zurich, there are rules for things that cannot be explained. But when a final entry appears in the archive that should not exist, this fragile balance begins to unravel.

Das Hexencafé am Zürichsee: Der letzte Eintrag is a standalone fantasy visual novel about choices, memories, and the question of what should be recorded – and what might have been better left unwritten.

Follow Liva Kern through a story filled with unusual encounters, mysterious records, and impossible events. Aurelia, Momo, Mary Kanzi, and other characters become part of a mystery whose outcome depends on your decisions.

YOUR CHOICES MATTER

Conversations and decisions shape the course of the story. What you believe, whom you trust, and how you deal with the final entry can have far-reaching consequences.

MULTIPLE ENDINGS

Your decisions lead to different outcomes. Not every path ends the same way – and some consequences only reveal themselves much later.

A STANDALONE STORY

No prior knowledge is required. The story was designed as a standalone experience and takes you directly into the world of the Hexencafé on Lake Zurich.

ATMOSPHERIC FANTASY

Explore a quiet and mysterious world blending the atmosphere of Lake Zurich with magic and things that probably should never appear in an official record.

FEATURES

• Story-driven visual novel

• Meaningful choices

• Multiple endings

• Atmospheric fantasy story

• Full German and English text

• Three selectable text sizes: Normal, Large and Very Large

• Fully playable with a mouse

• No timed inputs or Quick Time Events

From small asteroids to massive warships

DashBreaker is an active incremental game where you dash through enemies and spend the resources you collect on permanent ship upgrades. Head out in a small craft, gather resources, unlock new abilities, and break through ever larger foes.

From single targets to sweeping destruction

At first, breaking a single asteroid takes your full attention. As your upgrades add up, you can pierce tougher enemies, spread your attacks to nearby targets, and bring down whole groups at once. The same single dash delivers a completely different result.

Gather more. Come back stronger.

The resources you bring back from each sortie fuel your next upgrades. Return to base to boost your attack power, widen your collection range, and keep your craft fighting longer. The more enemies you destroy and resources you gather, the closer you get to the next ability you want to unlock.

Break through the battles that once held you back

Start in a mining zone dotted with small asteroids, then advance into battlefields defended by missiles and massive warships. Enemies you once struggled to break through become new proof of your growing strength. Carve through enemy groups with stronger dashes and take on bigger targets.

Data Breach Inc. is an arcade incremental about breaking into hostile corporate infrastructure one risky sortie at a time. Pilot a breach rig, mine the firewall for resources, crack daemon cores, extract before the run turns ugly, and use the payout to make the next breach go deeper.

Every flight is part action run, part upgrade puzzle. You choose how hard to push: carve a safe route, chase valuable blocks, pressure a daemon core, or turn back early and bank the haul. Money, XP, and root kernels feed permanent upgrades for damage, attack speed, cargo, fuel, drones, range, payout scaling, and core-cracking power.

The firewall does not sit still. Deeper layers hit harder, daemon cores fight back, and defensive pressure forces cleaner routes instead of mindless grinding. Learn the layout, tune your rig, and turn messy extraction runs into faster clears.

The demo is built around defeating the demo breach and chasing a cleaner time on the Defeat Demo leaderboard. The full Data Breach Inc. structure also connects side operations into the campaign, including Red Sky Defense and Deepcore, with resources and unlocks feeding back into the central breach.

Features:

- Arcade breach sorties built around mining, movement, survival, and extraction

- Persistent firewall progress across runs

- Permanent upgrades for damage, speed, cargo, fuel, drones, range, payouts, and core damage

- Daemon core encounters with escalating defensive pressure

- Multiple resource paths: cash, XP, and root kernels

- Demo clear target with leaderboard-ready timing

- Connected side operations in the full Data Breach Inc. structure

- Short runs with long-term incremental progression

Only you can shape her future.

Take in the last princess of a fallen kingdom and help her build a new life.
Through friendship, romance, growth, and hardship,
your choices will shape the path she takes and the woman she becomes.
An emotional life-sim RPG with a rich story and dozens of unique endings.

☀️ Schedule Management

Manage your daughter's schedule!
Gold or education? Choose wisely.
From taverns to the Royal Academy, every choice leaves its mark.
Will she grow up to be a troublemaker, or a proper lady? It's up to you.

How will you raise her?

🔥 Explore dungeons and rescue the captive elf!

Deep within the dungeon, a white-haired elf is being held in chains.

Save him, defeat the monsters, and earn your fortune!

Meet a cast of unforgettable characters!

A smug rival. A dangerous heartthrob. A headstrong princess from a distant land.
Shape your daughter's bonds with them, and watch her story unfold...

Dress up your daughter!

A wide variety of outfits awaits her.

Take a vacation with your daughter!

Melt away her stress and pick up new stats along the way. (Though it won't come cheap!)
🍀 If luck is on your side, you might even run into a heroine!

Enemies can become allies.

Allies can become lovers.

Or perhaps... everyone can stay together.

One choice changes everything.

One is never the only answer. Not in love. Not in fate.

Take part in grand festivals!

Cook. Fight. Debate. Dance.

Prove your daughter's talents and take home the trophies!
When night falls, exclusive shops open and fortunes await.

Multiple Endings

The Gloom is swallowing the realms, and only the light of the Dawnheart holds it back.

Take up your post, Keeper — raise crystal spires along the road, hold the gates, and carry the last light from the meadows to the Heart of the Gloom itself.

Defend Alone or Together


Play the entire game solo, or hold a shared board in online co-op with up to 9 Keepers.

Invite Steam friends, join with a 6-character code, or browse open lobbies — no server setup, no account beyond Steam.

The Long Dawn — a Roguelite Run


One huge generated board, up to four realms on it, and no gold at all.

Every wave you clear deals you three cards: attack speed, crits, chain lightning, poison spread, a new tower school, a rare keystone that rewrites how your spires fight. Cards roll from common to legendary, so a lucky draft is a run you'll remember.

Place towers from a pool of Foundations, ascend your schools through the draft instead of buying tiers, and hold the Keep to the final wave — 30 on Easy, 125 on Nightmare.

Every board comes from a seed you can share, and a run in progress is saved so you can walk away and come back.

Run it in co-op and every Keeper drafts their own cards, for their own towers — so one of you goes for burning damage, one for slows and shields, and the board ends up something neither of you would have built alone.

Finish a run and your time goes on the leaderboard for that difficulty. The Keep holds, or it doesn't.

A Voice-Acted Story Campaign


Fight through 21 handcrafted missions across 7 realms — meadow, desert, frozen pass, emberwood, shadowlands, hollow deep, and the Heart of the Gloom — with 7 bosses and 15 optional Keeper Tales that fill in the world's memory.

Every line of dialogue is fully voiced in both English and Hebrew.

Build Your Defense


Ten spires — Cannon, Archer, Frost, Storm, Ballista, Venom, Sun, Dusk, Echo and Prism — each with three tiers and a branching specialization at the top.

Carry a loadout of four into battle, tune it with 7 runes, relocate a misplaced spire, and pick one of four Keeper classes with their own battlefield abilities: Builder, Warden, Mystic, or Mender.

Know What's Coming


41 kinds of Gloom walk the road — splitters, taunters, armour-smiths that shield the crowd, striders that laugh at frost, foes that resist steel and foes that resist magic.

Every one of them has a counter, and the first time you meet one the game shows you what it is.

No single choke point solves every map.

Read the Battlefield


Every tower keeps a record.

Open a spire to see its damage, DPS and kills, or hit Tab mid-wave for the full board report — damage share, live DPS, and the support work that never shows up as damage.

The end-of-mission report names the tower that carried you.

Choose Your Challenge


Four difficulties from Easy to Nightmare.

Earn medals on every mission, chase 3-star clears, and prove yourself with Nightmare medals on all 21 — if you can.

Quick Play, Endless, and the Maze


Fifteen skirmish maps across four realms in three more modes: Classic waves, Endless survival, and Maze — an open arena where you place the gates and wall your own labyrinth.

Separate Endless records to push, with Steam leaderboards.

Rival Keeps (PvP)


Two teams, two boards, up to 6v6.

Defend your Keep while the rival team's waves pressure theirs — last light standing wins.

Forge and Share


Build your own maps and full multi-mission campaigns — with story screens, custom wave tuning, even custom towers and enemies — in the built-in Forge editor, and publish them straight to Steam Workshop.

Co-op-flagged community campaigns can be played together online.

Earn Everything by Playing


Crystals earned in missions unlock 10 Keep skins and 6 Keeper appearances.

No microtransactions, no paid currency — the shop takes crystals, not money.

For Our Hebrew-Speaking Players / לשחקנים דוברי עברית


המשחק כולו זמין בעברית — כולל ממשק מלא מימין לשמאל ודיבוב עברי מלא של כל שורות הסיפור.

הגנו על לב-השחר, לבד או יחד עם חברים.

DAY 31

Thirty-one days ago, something buried under Harrow was released, and the dead started walking. You made it this far. But somewhere in the dark, something with wrong teeth found you, and now there's a mark in your blood that the darkness can read. A countdown. Not a virus. A curse.

When it finishes writing, you stop being you.

YOU'RE ALREADY BITTEN

Every run starts with the clock already ticking. What buys you time isn't medicine. It's nerve: the raw force of will that keeps a person human. Fight, and you generate it. Kill, and you claw back what the mark has taken. Hide, freeze, give up, and it drains.

Standing still is how you turn.

MAKE THE DEAL

Between the waves waits Vessel. He's never given his name; the survivors just call him the Merchant. He carries a ledger bound in something that isn't leather, and he sells suppressants that slow the mark, ammunition that shouldn't exist, and weapons that were never made on this earth. His price is your nerve, the only currency he respects. And every purchase buys you more time to earn more nerve to spend at his stall.

He's very good at his job.

Beside him sits Mara. She's never spoken to anyone who lived to report it, but she watches you the whole time you're trading. Her feet stop swinging the moment you walk in.

SURVIVE THE WAVES

Relentless wave-based combat where the real enemy is the clock. Push your infection back from the brink with kill streaks, or watch it tip you over the edge into something else.

Two ways to die: bleed out, or turn. They are not the same.

THE ARSENAL

Pistols, rifles, shotguns, and a spiked bat you'll pull off a corpse in the basement. You carry two guns at a time — buying a third means leaving one behind, so choose what you can live without.

Restore the hospital's power, open the elevator, and push down into the flooded dark beneath St. Harrow, where the things that got out of the quarantine ward went to finish changing.

HORDE MODE

No infection. No countdown. Just you, the dead, and how long you can hold.

FEATURES

An infection-clock system that turns every run into a race against yourself

Spend "nerve," earned through aggression, as your only currency

Vessel the Merchant and Mara, the doll you'll never quite stop thinking about

Relentless wave combat with a horror atmosphere built on dread, not jump scares

Brutal, physical gunplay with dismemberment and gore

The wards of St. Harrow and the flooded basement beneath them

Horde Mode for when you want the fight without the clock

A mystery buried in the Merchant's ledger

HOW LONG BEFORE YOU TURN?

Harrow takes everyone eventually. Make it earn you.

The full version is planned to add:

  • The second floor of St. Harrow, which isn't built yet. It's the next thing I'm making.

  •  A real ending. Right now the run stops once you drain the flooded junction; the full version finishes what starts there.

  • Steam Achievements: full achievement support.

  • Steam Workshop support, so the community can build on the game directly.

  • More enemies and weapons, including further additions to the Merchant's stock.

  • The remaining audio pass: survivor voice lines and the full set of infection audio cues.

  • Balance and pacing changes driven by Early Access feedback. This is the point of the whole exercise, so expect this list to grow based on what players actually report.

Day 31 is playable and stable, but it is not finished. Here is exactly where it stands.

What's in right now:

- The complete core loop: wave-based combat, the infection countdown through all four stages, the nerve economy, and the Merchant between waves. This loop is finished, and it's where you'll spend your time.

- Two connected areas: the ground floor of St. Harrow hospital and the flooded basement beneath it, with power restoration and the elevator linking them.

- A full arsenal: pistols, rifles, shotguns, melee, and the Merchant's stock, with a two-gun carry limit.

- Multiple enemy types including the shambling dead, hazmat crews, mutations in the basement, and the nurse.

- Two modes: the standard infection run, and Horde Mode with the countdown switched off.

- Four difficulty presets.

What is NOT in yet:

- The run currently ends after you drain the flooded junction. There is no conclusion past that point — the content simply stops. If you're buying for a finished story, wait for 1.0.

- The hospital's second floor hasn't been built yet. It's the next thing I'm making.

- Some later-stage infection effects are visual rather than mechanical.

- Survivor voice lines aren't recorded, and parts of the audio mix are still placeholder.

Expect bugs. There's a bug report link in the main menu, and I read every one.

Day by Day: Tokyo Student Diary is a pixel-art survival life simulation game about the everyday life of an international student in Japan.

After arriving in Tokyo, you'll start from scratch and face the realities of studying abroad. Find a place to live, keep yourself fed, learn Japanese, earn money through part-time jobs, manage your time, and take care of both your physical and mental well-being as you work toward your goals.

Every day offers only a limited amount of time. Will you spend it studying in the library to prepare for exams, or work at a convenience store, café, or Chinese restaurant to pay your bills? You can also cook, work out, visit hot springs, meet new people, and create your own story in the streets of Tokyo.

The game combines time management with survival mechanics. Hunger, sleep, mood, study progress, hygiene, and money all interact with one another, meaning every decision has lasting consequences. Studying hard may unlock better job opportunities, while staying up too late, living under constant stress, or running out of money can make life increasingly difficult.

As you progress, you'll unlock new locations, jobs, events, and relationships. Random events, unique character traits, and meaningful choices ensure that every playthrough offers a different journey and multiple possible endings.

Features

🎓 Experience the authentic daily life of an international student in Japan.

🏙️ Explore Tokyo freely, visiting schools, libraries, convenience stores, cafés, Chinese restaurants, gyms, city offices, and more.

💼 Take on part-time jobs to earn money and pay your rent and living expenses.

📚 Study Japanese, improve your skills, and build a brighter future.

🍱 Cook, shop, do laundry, rest, and manage every aspect of student life.

📊 Balance hunger, sleep, mood, study, hygiene, money, and other survival stats.

🎲 Enjoy random events, unique character traits, multiple progression paths, and high replayability.

🌸 Immerse yourself in charming pixel-art visuals and a warm, relaxing soundtrack that captures the atmosphere of Tokyo.

In a city full of opportunities, no one will decide your future for you.

Will you stay focused on your dreams and work hard?

Will you get distracted by entertainment and miss your exams?

Or will you discover your own way of living in Tokyo, one choice at a time?

Your study abroad journey begins today.

· The Adventure Never Stops

Daydream Cat: DreamSpirits Idle Adventure is a desktop idle RPG built around three-member teams, collecting, progression, and automatic combat.

Let your Dreamspirits keep adventuring in a corner of your desktop. Focus on work, browse the web, or watch a video, then return to make the decisions that matter: adjust your lineup, equip new gear, unlock talents, and send the journey onward.

The demo launches on October 6—your progress will carry over to the full game.

· Three Dreamspirits, Countless Combinations

Choose three members from 451 collectible Dreamspirits and build a team of your own.

Roles, races, elements, skills, innate affixes, and synergies all interact. Protect your main damage dealer, combine skill effects, or build an entire lineup around a favorite Dreamspirit—every adjustment can take your team farther.

· Step Away. The Battle Continues.

Your team automatically fights enemies, uses skills, and advances through stages. Even while you are away, it continues earning offline rewards.

There is no need to click endlessly. Decide how to develop your members, allocate resources, and refine your setup. Leave the fighting to your Dreamspirits and keep your time for yourself.

· A Collection Begins with a Dream Egg

Find Dream Eggs, hatch new companions, and discover Dreamspirits of different rarities—including rare Shiny variants.

Use fusion and evolution to raise the members you love, expand your Codex, and find the missing piece for your next team.

· Grow Through Equipment, Crafting, and Talents

Defeated enemies drop equipment, materials, and loot chests. Enhance equipment, socket bonuses, craft resources in the workshop, and plan your path through 132 talent nodes covering combat, collection, economy, and idle progression.

Every reward and every choice changes where your team goes next.

· Journey Deeper into the Dream

Challenge 5 map floors, 4 difficulty levels, and 200 stage combinations. Hunt for better equipment, hatch rarer Dreamspirits, and keep perfecting your three-member team.

Build your team. Adventure automatically. Keep dreaming.

Gather skill points to improve your character. Use massive destruction guns to shred hordes of zombies!

GORE! GOREE! GOREEE!

Dead 4 Now doesn’t flinch. Every hit is designed to feel heavy, messy, and final, with splatter, chunks, and brutal impact that turns every close call into a spectacle you earned.

Kill & Shred Hordes of Zombies

The outbreak doesn’t come in small numbers. Survive relentless, screen-filling waves and carve a path through the dead in bullet-hell chaos defined by constant movement, tight dodges, and aggressive crowd control.

Use Massive Destruction Guns!

Welcome to the show. Your family has already been invited.

Two fighters face off on an old television. Their dossiers and a hand of cards lie before you. Uncover hidden information, influence the odds, and pick the winner. A correct prediction earns you a reward. A mistake could cost someone you love their life.

Every favorite has a secret

Young, strong, confident. A wonderful candidate! A shame you haven’t seen his medical records yet.

Study fighting styles, preparation, personalities, and talents. Discover the injuries missing from those incomplete dossiers. A seasoned master or a healthy rookie—which advantages will matter in the ring?

Fighters gain experience, suffer injuries, and enter each bout in a different condition. Yesterday’s favorite could be today’s mistake.

Interference is encouraged

Strengthen your pick, undermine their opponent, and gather intelligence. Spend a card uncovering a secret or change the odds immediately? Use a powerful effect now or save it for the next fight?

Unlock 70 cards, complete challenges, and build a starting deck to suit your approach. Visit the shop and call in paid assistance. Even careful preparation leaves room for risk. Decide when you’re ready to take it.

Look after your family. You’ll need them.

Choose from three families with different abilities. Your loved ones help you through the tournament, but after a wrong prediction, you decide who faces the consequences. Lose a family member, and you lose their help, too.

Hostages can be ransomed—if you raise the money in time. Buy a card for the next fight or set something aside to bring a loved one home? We trust you have your priorities in order.

The show goes on

Enter tournaments around the world, with three formats and four difficulty levels for each. New fighter lineups and combinations of traits give you reasons to rethink your deck and try a different approach.

The fighters are ready. Your family is watching.

Make your Dead Bet.

ENTER TOKYO. EXTRACT ALIVE.

Dead Extraction is a top-down pixel-art extraction survival game set in a Tokyo devastated by a catastrophic infection. Enter hostile zones, search for weapons, equipment, and essential supplies, then reach an extraction point alive. Every extra room could contain something valuable—but the longer you stay, the greater the risk of losing everything.

EVERY OPERATION DEMANDS A DIFFERENT APPROACH.

Fight through ruined city streets, dangerous night zones, forests, and military facilities. Face infected swarms, armed scavengers, elite PMCs, and powerful bosses. Search-and-extract raids are joined by convoy operations, sniper missions, helicopter assaults, and large-scale battles.

SURVIVAL REQUIRES MORE THAN FIREPOWER.

Read enemy movements, control your firing angles, use cover, and choose your battles carefully. Health, infection, stress, hunger, and hydration must all be managed alongside limited ammunition and inventory space. If you die during an operation, the equipment and loot you were carrying will be lost.

BUILD A SHELTER WORTH RETURNING TO.

A successful extraction is only the beginning. Bring recovered supplies back to your shelter, manage food, water, electricity, and storage, and expand your defenses. Build walls, gates, and automated turrets, repair damaged structures, and prepare for attacks from infected hordes and hostile armed forces.

EVERY SURVIVOR HAS A STORY.

The survivors living in your shelter have their own personalities, abilities, emotions, and relationships. Morale and mental stability influence their behavior, while affection, resentment, crime, and punishment can reshape the entire community. Watch their personal logs, manage internal conflicts, and keep the shelter from collapsing from within.

WHAT YOU BRING HOME IS WHAT MATTERS.

Killing the most enemies does not make an operation successful. Know when to keep searching, when to fight, and when to escape with what you have.

Survive Tokyo. Secure what you need. Extract alive.

THE WORLD DIDN'T END ALL AT ONCE

It came apart over years. The cities emptied, then filled back up with

something else... There are still people out there. Fewer every week.

Dead Hand is a roguelike deckbuilder where you're one of them.

EVERY CARD COUNTS TWICE

Your cards are both your actions and your resources.

Play one and you act now. Keep it and you last longer.

There is never enough for both.

EIGHT BIOMES

A flooded metro, a zoo where the cages opened, an abandoned prison, a

blighted forest...

Each has its own enemies, its own events, its own boss.

The route between them changes every run.

SIX SURVIVORS

A cop, a zookeeper, a fighter, a hunter, a warrior, a sniper.

Each starts with a different deck, a different relationship with

resources, and a different reason for still being here.

WHAT YOU CARRY

Mementos from before, scavenged out of the ruins, that bend the rules of

the run. Gear to craft and repair. Consumables to save for the moment it

all goes wrong.

And hundreds of cards to find, combine and upgrade.

THE AESTHETIC OF CHAOS

Drawn in the raw style of 1990s American comics. Heavy ink, saturated

color. Every card, every enemy, every area reeks of the apocalypse.

Dead Hand is made by one person, evenings and weekends. Most of the

changes and balance passes come straight out of Discord feedback.

Studio Haute Roche, made in Belgium.

Your keyboard is the weapon.

Every correct key fires a shot. Every typo jams your gun. The horde doesn't wait while you look for the right letter.

Dead Keys is a typing roguelite set in a pixel-art zombie apocalypse. Type in 17 languages, alone, with a friend, or against one.

Every survivor plays differently, with their own passive and an ability you call in by typing its command: LAUNCH a rocket, go AKIMBO, pull the RIPCORD, throw a GRENADE or STERILIZE the street.

Hold the barricade for 50 waves. Build your run from 84 augments and face a boss every ten waves. Between runs you train your survivors, buy kits and unlock starter augments, so a losing run still moves you forward.


Four years after it started, a dead radio station comes back on for one second. EVACUATION AVAILABLE. SIGNAL STATION SIX. DAWN.

Five short missions, one story, told by the survivors themselves while you type. Find out who is still up at Station Six, and decide what happens to it. Play it solo or with a friend.



No builds. No abilities. No excuses. Just sentences and a minigun that spins faster the longer you keep your rhythm. Live WPM, accuracy and personal records, plus a Daily run: one seed a day, the same for every player in the world.




Hold the barricade with a friend over Steam or LAN, race them in Endless VS or play with up to 3 friends in GROUNDS mode. When one of you finally breaks, there is only one thing left to do: say that your cat walked across your keyboard.

We can code. We cannot draw. What we did, you'll notice xd.

Overview

A strategy roguelite with real-time tactical battles. Your goal is to destroy the capital of the human kingdom. You begin with only a handful of minions—just enough to raid villages. Gather resources and increase your Dark Power by razing settlements. Build a formidable army, learn new abilities, and prepare for the final assault.

Every battle matters. You have only one chance to conquer each settlement. If you fail, it will be granted divine protection and become forever beyond your reach.

 

Army

There are three ways to expand your army. You can use bones to create minions and skeletal warriors. By spending your Dark Power, you can recruit creatures from Hell. You can also summon wild beasts to serve you. Your units grow stronger by gaining experience in battle, so it is wise to keep them alive.

Battles

Battles are fought in real time. At the start of the game, you can issue only a single general attack order. By spending your Dark Power, you can unlock new command abilities, giving you greater control over your army. Later on, you will be able to organize your forces into multiple hordes, allowing them to fight with greater coordination and efficiency. Satan will judge your performance as a commander, and your rewards will reflect the effectiveness of your leadership.

Map

You begin your campaign at the edge of the map, and your ultimate goal is to reach the capital at the heart of the kingdom. There are many possible routes to your destination, but if an attack on a settlement is repelled, the road through it will be permanently blocked. Along the way, you will encounter camps, villages, towns, forts, and monasteries. Each type of settlement is defended by different kinds of troops and yields different loot when razed.

Resources

The game features three resources: Dark Power, Bones, and Iron. You gain Dark Power by destroying settlements and killing enemies. Spend it to unlock new abilities, learn powerful spells, and upgrade your forces. Bones collected from the dead can be used to create minions and skeletal warriors. Iron is acquired by plundering settlements and salvaging the weapons and armor of fallen soldiers. Use it to forge stronger arms and armor for your army.

Abilities

The game features dozens of abilities to unlock. These include battlefield commands, powerful combat spells, creature summoning, and permanent unit upgrades. Spend your Dark Power to unlock them and gain access to new powers.

One empty floor. One client. Build it into the backbone of the cloud

You begin with a bare room and a single server you assembled by hand. Grow it into a sprawling enterprise data center: rows of hundreds of racks, redundant power and networking, massive storage fabric, and a steady stream of clients pushing heavy workloads across hardware you designed yourself every day.

Design your own servers

You do not buy servers off a shelf. You build them.

  • Choose every piece of hardware and where it goes: processors, memory, storage drives, network cards, GPUs, and enterprise AI accelerators, each with its own cost, performance, and power draw.

  • Build the right server for the work. A server tuned for log processing is wasted money on an AI training run.

  • Unlock new chassis, board form factors, appliances and more as you grow, from compact single socket nodes to dense intertwined GPU, CPU and storage clusters.

Build out the facility

A great server is nothing without the room around it, and this is where the real engineering begins.

  • Lay out your floor rack by rack and slot your servers into place.

  • Feed them power through UPS units and distribution panels, but mind your circuits, because a single overloaded run can make an entire aisle of servers go dark.

  • Stitch it all together using network appliances and cables, storage fabrics and more to form the networks and clusters each workload demands.

Sign clients. Deliver uptime

Customers arrive with real workloads: web hosting, video rendering, cold storage, financial trading, cloud gaming, and more. Take on what your hardware can actually deliver, place it on the right server, and collect the revenue. Staying online is the hard part.

  • Hardware wears out and fails. Storage drives die, and the RAID level you chose decides whether that is a minor event or a data loss disaster.

  • Fall behind on the power bill and the utility starts cutting your supply.

  • Hire technicians to repair and maintain the floor once it grows beyond what you can manage on your own.

Hyperscale

  • Tie dozens of racks together into a single compute cluster for specialized and lucrative high performance workloads requiring thousands of CPU cores. 

  • Stand up GPU clusters for AI training and inference, the workloads everyone is racing to host.

  • Pool storage across racks into massive petabyte sized pools. Don't forget to protect yourself by configuring your drive arrays properly and setting up replication mirrors for redundancy.

  • Your job as the datacenter architect is to balance system load, uptime, cost, and resiliency to keep your clients happy.

Run it your way

A limited research budget and four specialization paths (Compute, Storage, AI, and Operations) mean every facility you build turns out different. Go all in on raw compute, become a storage provider, chase the AI boom, or squeeze every watt and every dollar with operational efficiency.

Built for the IT minded

If you have ever racked a server, argued about RAID levels, or run a home lab just because you could, this one is for you. Name your servers, query your fleet, and fire off batch commands from the built in terminal CLI if you are an experienced tech. It is the data center you always wanted to run, without the noise, the heat, or the power bill.

Features

  • Build servers part by part, balancing performance, power, and cost

  • Plan a real facility: power, networking, cooling, and structured cabling

  • Manage system configurations in detail to create complex clusters and networks

  • Dozens of client workloads, from quick batch jobs to long term tenants paying daily

  • A living simulation of hardware faults, drive failures, power crises, and repairs

  • Compute clusters, GPU and AI systems, and multi rack storage at the high end

  • Four specialization paths that reshape how your facility grows

  • 100 operator ranks of new hardware and capabilities

  • An optional command line terminal for power users

  • Single player, played at your own pace

Buy low, sell high. Master the art of the deal.

Deal Flipper is a first-person flipping sim where the entire market lives online. Scour a marketplace full of underpriced treasure, haggle with sellers in real-time chat, and resell your finds for profit. But here's the catch: every trader thinks, reacts, and bargains differently. Read them right, and the deal is yours. Lowball the wrong seller, and they'll walk away, taking the item with them.



🔍 Hunt the Marketplace
Scroll through an endless feed of secondhand listings. A vintage gold watch for $10? A "Ming Dynasty vase (probably)"? The deals are out there, buried between the junk. Spot what's underpriced, judge what's worth your money, and open a chat the moment you see an opportunity.



💬 Master the Negotiation
This is where Deal Flipper sets itself apart. Every deal is won or lost in chat and every trader has a profile. Their Knowledge, Patience, Greed, and Stubbornness shape how they bargain. Check a seller's stats before you make your move: a greedy one holds out for more, a patient one won't blink at your lowball, and a knowledgeable trader knows exactly what their item's worth. Push the wrong seller and they'll snap back or refuse to sell at all. Read each profile, adapt your offers, and outdeal them all.



📦 Stock, List & Flip
Once a deal closes, your package arrives. Place it on your shelves, then relist it on the marketplace, at your price. That $8 watch becomes an "$89 vintage heirloom." Flipping isn't just about buying low; it's about selling smart.



📈 Build Your Empire
Start with pocket change and a single desk. Track every item's full profit history: daily, weekly, and monthly. Study how the market moves, and turn small flips into big margins. What begins as a pocket change hustle becomes a full-blown trading operation. Every item is its own little economy, and mastering them all is how empires are built.



Features:

💻A marketplace that never sleeps — no storefront, no foot traffic, just you and an endless feed of deals

💬Real-time chat negotiation — haggle your way to the perfect price, message by message

🧠Trader profiles that matter — every seller's Knowledge, Patience, Greed, and Stubbornness shapes the deal

📦The full flip loop — hunt, haggle, stock, relist, and sell at a profit

📊Deep profit tracking — follow each item's daily, weekly, and monthly history and learn how prices move

🏪From one desk to an empire — scale a pocket-change hustle into a full-blown trading machine

Dealer Principal: The Dealership Simulator puts you in charge of a franchised new-car dealership—not just the showroom, but the entire business behind it.

Walk the store, work with your managers, make deals, manage inventory, build relationships with your manufacturer, and keep every department pulling in the same direction. Every decision ultimately comes back to one question: can you run a profitable dealership without destroying the customer experience, your staff, or your cash flow?

Run the Whole Dealership

A dealership is much more than selling cars. Manage the interconnected departments and systems that keep the store alive:

  • New and used vehicle inventory

  • Vehicle acquisition, trades, pricing, and aging

  • Sales and deal desking

  • Finance and insurance

  • OEM allocation, incentives, and franchise expectations

  • Service and parts operations

  • Recon and vehicle readiness

  • Staffing, payroll, and department performance

  • Customer satisfaction and reputation

  • Dealership expenses, debt, floorplan, and cash flow

Work the Deal, Not Just the Spreadsheet

Meet customers on the sales floor, structure transactions at the Sales Desk, evaluate trades, work through financing, and send completed deals into F&I.

A deal that looks great on gross profit can still hurt the dealership if the trade is wrong, the inventory is aging, financing falls apart, or the customer leaves unhappy.

Live With Your Inventory Decisions

Vehicles are working capital sitting on asphalt.

Decide what to stock, what to trade for, what to acquire used, what to discount, and when to cut your losses. Balance availability against carrying cost, aging, demand, and the cash your dealership needs elsewhere.

Manage the Franchise Relationship

Operating a franchised dealership means answering to more than your customers.

Work within manufacturer expectations, vehicle allocation, incentives, training requirements, facility standards, and performance targets while still making the decisions that are right for your store.

Fixed Operations Matter

Sales may get the attention, but service and parts can determine whether the dealership actually works.

Manage service capacity, customer-pay work, warranty business, technicians, parts availability, and the customer experience after the vehicle leaves the showroom.

A Dealership You Can Actually Walk Through

Dealer Principal combines detailed business simulation with a first-person, physical dealership. Move between the showroom, Sales Desk, F&I offices, management offices, customer lounge, service department, and other operational areas instead of running the entire company from one abstract menu.

Build a Better Store

Start with a believable single-point franchised dealership and improve it through better decisions, stronger departments, better employees, smarter inventory management, and disciplined capital allocation.

There is no single perfect way to run the store. You decide what kind of dealer principal you want to become.

"Congratulations, Mr. President. Welcome to your office."

In this dark, satirical roguelite strategy game, you take the seat as the leader of a dystopian regime. Your only weapon is your stamp. Every day, your desk is piled high with documents full of absurd, dangerous, and moral dilemmas; the choice is yours. But remember: in bureaucracy, every choice has a price.

Your Choice, The Nation's Price

Will you raise salaries to stop the brain drain, or import cheap labor from abroad? Every document throws you into a moral and economic dilemma. Slam your stamp down and face the devastating consequences your decisions have on the People, the Economy, the Media, or the Military.

If the phone rings, answer it... Not that you have a choice!

You’re not just stamping papers at your desk. Answer incoming calls, strike secret deals, or get dragged into dark conspiracies. Every phone conversation brings you one step closer to your inevitable fate.

Your End is Approaching

Your choices can't please everyone. When you upset the delicate balance and anger the wrong people, you'll hear those cold footsteps echoing toward your office. The end of your regime might come through a roaring riot in the streets, or a silent visitor walking right up to your desk.

Learn from Death... Upgrade Your Skills!

Every death at the desk is just a preparation for your next regime. Use the skill tree between runs to unlock permanent upgrades and secure your path to the grand finale. And these investments aren't just boring stats; for instance, an upgraded bodyguard doesn't just stand behind you like a potted plant. He is a highly "interesting" fixer who is loyal to you to the very end.

You Cannot Rule Forever!

When you answer that ringing phone, you will find yourself right in the middle of a mysterious, branching chain of events. If you manage to survive this challenging process and reach the end of the phone calls, the grand finale will be waiting for you. But be very careful about what you choose! The decisions you make throughout the process directly determine which options will be locked in the finale. Thanks to closing doors and brand-new paths opening up, every new playthrough will offer you a completely different political experience.

Immersive Gameplay

In Death & Taxes, the realms of D&D and the video game universe combine for a brand new experience. Traverse through the depth of gameplay where your every strategic choice will determine the fate of your adventurer. Join forces with others to overcome the trials of this ever-evolving world, or go forth on your own to craft a unique destiny.

​

Mold your future with each fate-defining decision. Every action taken uses energy and increases a skill, growing your character in some way.  Each skill has a corresponding ability that builds as you master that skill.  Continue to grow those abilities, making you stronger, smarter and more adept, until your inevitable demise.  

​

But it does not end there...  ​In Death & Taxes, what you do in life, echoes beyond. For in this hardcore, permadeath RPG, your character's passing is but a new chapter. The glory you earned in life will fuel your continuing journey after death, until you rise again.

Rich Lore

Deep game lore developed over years of gameplay as a Table Top RPG has built an entire world for new players to discover, explore and develop.  
​
As you don the mantle of a nomadic adventurer, the canvas of this world unfurls before you, steeped in shadows of discoveries and secrets long buried by the hands of time.  You slowly learn through discovery of artifacts and ruins within the area, the history and the fate of those that came before you, and the place of the adventurers within that story.  And very soon after, you may discover that the threat still looms to this day—a harrowing prophecy of doom that calls out to the adventurers of our age, waiting to be rewritten.

What is Death & Taxes?

Death & Taxes is an RPG like no other.  With origins as a Virtual Table Top game, it has the gritty feel of old school D&D but with mechanics designed for continuous, open world, video game play.  In Death & Taxes, everything you do matters, in this life...and in the next.  For your character will die in this hardcore, permadeath RPG.  But Death is not the end. 

In this living world, players will group up to build their cities, collect resources and improve their characters, altering the landscape along the way.  Gather, Craft, Build, Explore and Fight your way across the untamed land, bringing civilization with you. Through your efforts, you will discover that this land is much older and with a history far deeper than you could have possibly imagined.  

Become a trader, a hero, a legend...even a god. In Death & Taxes you can pursue anything...but only two things are certain.

The Death of D&T

  • Endgame Reinvented - In Death & Taxes, Death is your endgame!  We're not running around and racking up numbers for nothin'.  When the life of your character ends, for some players, this will be just the beginning.  Everything you do in life will result in power in the Afterlife.  

  • Become a god - Influence players and other factions, build labyrinths to your glory and shape the very land itself.  It is the ultimate goal for any power hungry adventurer.  Will the people on your world love you, worship you...or fear you?

When I die, do I start over?

Not completely.  You will have the option to create a new character in your existing faction after death.  Your decedents will be able to access your faction bank to collect their inheritance.  Plus anyone can loot your corpse, and your will have the general advantage of knowing where you died.  In addition, you will receive all the benefits that your faction has built up, making progression just a little bit easier.  

The Taxes of D&T

This game is intended to be Free to Play with the primary monetization method being the sale of in game gold.  This gold is spent principally on taxes to your faction.  Outside of some very specific situations, all taxes collected by your faction in gold will be used by your faction to grow, affording players all sorts of benefits to help their characters grow.  The more progressed the faction, the more quickly a newly arrived character can get up to speed.  

Why Taxes?

Lets face it, an online game requires income to continue to exist.  The Tax system is a unique approach that is not quite a subscription model.  It allows players to pay for the game by spending money or time.  You can either spend some time in game farming up materials to create and sell goods and use that gold to pay taxes, or you can just spend some money to pay your taxes and buy some of the things people are selling, spending less time.
