Dive into the depths of a semi-abandoned research complex on a remote planetoid and face a living nightmare! Step into the roles of station personnel and try to unite as a team to fix the facility’s failing systems, carving a path toward your own survival. Collect vital data and samples, gather and process biomaterials, rescue missing staff members, restore various station subsystems, and clear each level of an unknown lifeform — one floor at a time.

The unidentified lifeform is constantly hunting you: avoid direct encounters or fight it off with whatever tools you can find.

Join and reconnect to the game session anytime. Gain experience points for any useful contributions you make.

Death Imminent is a dark first-person survival horror game that features:

  • A cooperative adventure with stealth elements

  • Squad control and tactical gameplay

  • Resource management

  • Retro aesthetics

  • Unlockable character classes and perks

  • Exploration of a twisted, ever-changing living labyrinth

  • A bleak, atmospheric soundtrack

Summon Your Army! Unleash Your Combos! Death To The Deathless!

Cultivators have stolen fate itself, throwing the cycle of rebirth out of balance. At last, the underworld has sent someone to collect the immortals’ debt.

Wield the underworld’s command token and recruit spirits, beasts, and wandering warriors. Build your own debt-collecting squad in this roguelike squad builder inspired by Chinese folklore.

Origami Art Style

`The game features minions, enemies, and interfaces designed with distinct origami styles

Summoning and Combat

`Summon minions on the board, leveraging the synergy between adjacent positions and abilities to counter enemies.

Enemies advance toward the player's side each turn, with varying sizes and abilities imposing different battlefield pressures.

`Each turn requires assessing the positions of minions, open spaces, and enemies on the field to determine how to continue summoning and handle elite and boss battles.

Subordinates and Artifact Construction

`Recruit followers and collect magical artifacts during the journey, gradually forming your own combat team.

·Subordinates possess various attack methods and trigger effects, while artifacts can further alter damage, combos, or other abilities.

`Choose subsequent rewards based on existing followers to enable synergies among the team's effects.

Journey and Chance

`The chapter alternates between combat and non-combat events.

`You can visit the Ghost Market to purchase items, explore ancient seals and the Gates of the Dead, or enhance your maximum life through opportunities like the Upwelling Lotus.

`The event queue displays multiple options simultaneously, allowing you to decide which card to process first. You can also use turn tokens to switch non-combat events, seeking those suitable for your current team.

You are a billionaire.
Tax season has arrived.
Suddenly, money is a medical emergency.

In Death by Taxes, the only way to survive is to get poor on purpose. Click to buy ordinary things in obscene quantities, unlock faster ways to burn cash, and race your balance to zero before the tax bill catches up with you.

You start with one billion dollars and one very serious problem: it is still yours. Click to buy everyday items in ridiculous quantities, unlock faster ways to spend, and empty your account before the tax bill arrives. Your goal is not to become rich. Your goal is to survive TAXES.

Every terrible financial decision unlocks another. Work through a huge skill tree packed with abilities, stronger clicks, faster purchases, and upgrades that turn casual shopping into an industrial operation. Choose a path, stack its bonuses, and then discover that the tree is much bigger than it first looked.

Coffee, food, cigars, gadgets - anything will do, as long as the money keeps moving. Start with ordinary purchases, then combine skills and abilities until every click sets off an avalanche of waste. The numbers get bigger, the screen gets messier, and your balance finally starts moving in the right direction: down.

Doing all the shopping yourself is terribly middle class. Recruit collectors and other helpful NPCs to buy things on your behalf and keep parts of the spending machine running. They can handle the busywork, but they will not solve everything for you. Stay sharp, use your abilities, and keep the money disappearing.

At the end of every spending segment, someone will try to stop you from making an even worse financial decision. Defeat a unique boss, break through their defenses, and unlock more powerful ways to burn cash. Beat the boss, take the upgrade, and move on to something much more expensive.

FOUR FRIENDS. ONE JOB. EVERYONE HAS SOMETHING TO OVERCOME

What could go wrong? Practically everything!

DEBUILDERS is a chaotic cooperative game for four players, in which communication, creativity, and teamwork are the only things that separate your crew from complete failure on the construction site

You've been hired to renovate houses, complete construction projects, and finish every job on time and up to standard.

Sounds simple

It isn't

Each member of your crew experiences the world differently. You'll need to understand their strengths, work around their limitations, and figure out how to accomplish the job together

Because nobody gets the job done alone

WORK TOGETHER. ADAPT. DON'T PANIC

Every player has different abilities and different challenges

You can't simply play your character like everyone else. You'll need to learn what your teammates can—and can't—do, then figure out how to work around those differences

That means communicating. A lot. Point. Shout. Warn. Guide. Coordinate

And when your carefully crafted plan inevitably falls apart...

Laugh and try again, because in DEBUILDERS, sometimes the funniest moments happen when everything goes completely wrong

MEET THE CREW

DEADLINE - The Planner

Deadline is the only worker who can see the complete project plan on his tablet

He knows what needs to happen. He knows where everything goes. He just has to convince three other people to actually do it

Navigate the crew through each project, identify what needs to be done, and keep everyone moving toward the deadline

You have the plan. Your team has to make it happen

SQUINT- The Powerhouse

Squint is incredibly strong and can break through obstacles that would stop everyone else

Unfortunately, he's extremely nearsighted

He can smash through a wall

He just needs someone to tell him which wall

Point him in the right direction, give him a target, and RUN!

MELATONY - The Wild Card

Melatony - master of delicate work. He's capable, resourceful, and always ready to jump in and help the team

As long as he's awake

When the sleep hits, everything changes. He can suddenly lose his bearings, stumble into danger, or find himself in exactly the wrong place at exactly the wrong time

So keep him moving. Keep an eye on him

And no matter what you do... WATCH OUT!

EASEL - The Color Specialist

Easel sees the world in monochrome. He's an expert painter that is completely colorblind

So - if the instructions simply say “paint the wall beige,” Easel is about to make some very interesting design choices

Someone needs to guide him, identify the right colors, and make sure the beautiful renovation doesn't turn into a very expensive art experiment

Communication has never been more important

PHYSICS IS YOUR FRIEND

Until it isn't

Swing heavy tools. Move furniture. Break through walls. Navigate hazards. Work around your environment

Every object has weight. Every action has consequences

And every construction worker knows the most important rule:

NEVER KNOCK DOWN A LOAD-BEARING WALL

Seriously. Probably...

CO-OP CHAOS

DEBUILDERS is built around playing together

Your team's success depends on understanding each player's strengths and limitations—and figuring out how to compensate for them

One player may need to guide another

Someone may need to clear a path

Someone may need to keep watch

And someone will almost certainly do something they were specifically told not to do

Communication isn't just part of the game. It is the heart of the game

GET BETTER. GET EQUIPPED. GET THE JOB DONE

Complete contracts to unlock new tools, equipment, cosmetics, and ways to customize your crew (available in early access)

As the jobs get harder, your team will need to get smarter, communicate better, and adapt to new challenges

Because the goal isn't to be perfect. The goal is to figure out how to succeed together

MORE THAN A GAME ABOUT LIMITATIONS

At its heart, DEBUILDERS is about something simple:

We all have things we struggle with

Sometimes you have to find your own way through a world that wasn't built for you. Sometimes you need someone else to help you see a solution. And sometimes a challenge that seems like a weakness can become the thing that pushes you to discover a new strength

DEBUILDERS takes that idea and turns it into something you can experience with your friends - with plenty of chaos and laughter along the way

You don't have to overcome everything alone

Different strengths. Different struggles. One team

READY TO GET TO WORK?

Grab your friends. Pick your crew. Read the plan. Communicate. Adapt

And whatever you do...

DON'T TOUCH THAT LOAD-BEARING WALL!

The road doesn't end. You do.

Decadrive is a top-down arcade racer about one impossible commute: endless traffic, a fuel gauge that's always dying, and ten phases that loop back around harder, faster, and meaner every cycle. You don't finish this road — you see how far you get before it finishes you.

THE RUN

Thread the needle between trucks at full speed. Every overtake feeds your combo. Every near-miss pays. Every mistake is the last one — until you hit retry, because you will hit retry.

POWER TRIP

Seven ways to cheat death: nitro through the gap, shield through the crash, slow-mo through the impossible, EMP the whole screen clean, turn ghost, drag coins in with the magnet, and pray for fuel rain when the needle hits red.

THE ROAD FIGHTS BACK

Some phases don't just throw traffic at you. Bosses own this highway — learn their patterns or become part of the asphalt. Clear phases 5 and 10 and hazard arenas (Roadbreaker, Siege Warlord) turn the road into a gauntlet.

EARN YOUR RIDE

Every run pays out. Spend it in the garage — new cars, new colors — and climb a skill tree that turns your next run from desperate to dangerous. XP, credits, shop upgrades: dying has never been this productive.

ONE MORE RUN

Beat all ten phases? The road laughs and starts cycle two. Chase your high score, hunt 15 in-game achievements, and find out where your limit really is.

  • Pure single-player arcade — no waiting, no lobbies, just you and the road
  • Survival mode for when the campaign feels too polite
  • UI in 9 languages: English, Portuguese (BR), Spanish, French, German, Japanese, Simplified Chinese, Russian, Korean
  • Keyboard and gamepad friendly

Decalcomanie is a platformer puzzle game set in a paper world.

DECALCOMANIE!

Create tiles and fold to make your own path!

SWITCH!

Jump into the paper world and control your dino!

OBSTACLES!

Let's find a way to avoid them!

KEY!

Collect the key to open the door and clear the stage!

Features

  • A variety of level designs!

  • Various obstacles like fixed tiles and holes!

  • Cute and charming visuals!

  • Stage-specific challenges!

BUILD YOUR DECK. HOLD THE LINE.

Deck & Defense is a real-time deckbuilding defense game where every card can change the battle. Assemble your deck before each run and protect your village against relentless waves of enemies.

Summon knights, wizards, dragons, and golems. Call down meteors, unleash lightning, spread poison, awaken powerful totems, and turn your cannon into a devastating war machine. Your cards cycle through the deck, so knowing when to play them is just as important as choosing which ones to bring.

POWER NOW. CONSEQUENCES LATER.

Overload a card by the crystal to unleash its empowered effect. Every sacrifice, however, increases the time it takes to draw your next cards, gradually slowing the rhythm of your defense.

Do you start overloading cards before the situation spirals out of control, or stay greedy and try to survive without them? Holding back preserves your momentum, but wait too long, and the run may end before you use the power you were saving.

RETURN STRONGER AFTER EVERY RUN.

Defeated enemies leave behind gold that you can spend on card packs and new additions to your collection. Refine your deck, remove unwanted cards, and merge three matching cards into a stronger version.

As you push deeper into each run, choose powerful augments that can transform your entire strategy. Build around reinforced summons, poison chain reactions, rapid-fire cannon shots, critical hits, unpredictable dice rolls and much much more. When your walls finally falls, rebuild your deck and find out how much further the next run can take you.

Create the Ultimate Team

Build a squad of pixel-art beasts and battle your way through the warp in this deck-building auto-battler roguelike. Draft beasts, equip abilities and items, collect relics, and destroy other players with broken builds.

Infinite Possibilities 

With over 100 beasts, hundreds of abilities and items, and 30+ run-defining relics, you decide how your team wins. Rush your enemy down before they get a chance to act, dump hundreds of buffs into one hyper-carry, eliminate key targets with surgical precision, smother the enemy team with waves of debilitating debuffs, or create a completely unique style of your own. With billions of possible combinations, no two runs are ever the same.

Create a Custom Deck

Theorycraft endlessly and fine-tune every aspect of your deck from beasts to relics, or get right into the action with starter decks and a rotating weekly deck. Easily share and swap custom decks with other players to break the meta together.

TONS more coming soon!

  • More Beasts!

  • More Abilities!

  • More Items!

  • More Relics!

  • More Mechanics!

  • More Ways to Play!

Unlock hundreds of cards and upgrades

Ride the Lightning!

50 heroes, each with unique powers and cards

  • 250 collectible cards

  • 50 heroes

  • 18 bosses across 3 acts

  • 13 languages, full controller and Steam Deck support

Forge your deck. Carve your path.

Deck Forge is a roguelike deckbuilder set in a dark-fantasy world, playable solo or in online co-op with up to four players. Start with a humble starter deck, draft new cards after every fight, bolt on game-changing relics, and venture through a world that never plays out the same way twice. Lose, learn, and forge a sharper deck on the next run.

Five classes, five ways to kill

• Warrior — A scrappy fighter of might and steel. Strikes hard, blocks harder, and stacks Strength to land devastating blows.

• Plague Doctor — Patient and methodical. Stacks Poison that ticks at end of turn and bleeds straight through Block.

• Warlock — Binds a Succubus to his will, a demoness who strikes anew each turn. Empower her, feed on souls, and let her tear the enemy apart.

• Sorceress — Channels arcane Orbs — Storm, Frost, Shadow, and Aether — that surge each turn. Stack Focus to amplify them, then unleash.

• Puppeteer — Never throws a punch. Banks the audience's Applause, spends it on showstoppers, and rehearses the Prima into a fight-ending finale.

Build something dangerous

• 375+ unique cards across the five classes, each with an upgraded form (750 in all) — attacks, skills, powers, curses, and class-defining mechanics.

• Relics that rewrite the rules — passive engines, build enablers, and signature relics unique to each class.

• Potions for the moment that would otherwise end your run.

• Upgrade at rest sites, thin your deck at the shop, and gamble on mysterious events.

Brave the trail

Three distinct acts — the Black Forest, the Caves below, and the seething Beehive — each with its own enemies, hazards, and a rotating cast of bosses, so the gauntlet keeps surprising you. Branching maps mean every choice between fight, shop, rest, treasure, and the unknown is a gamble with the run on the line.

Ten levels deeper

Beaten the gauntlet? Prestige mode layers ten escalating modifiers — tougher elites, leaner gold, nastier bosses, and a starting curse — for players who want the journey to bite back.

Features

• Five fully distinct classes, each with its own cards, mechanics, and signature relic.

• Online co-op for up to four players — open your run and friends drop in at any map node, or join a run already in progress.

• Hundreds of cards, relics, and potions to discover and combine.

• Three themed acts with rotating bosses and dangerous elites.

• Prestige 1–10 for escalating challenge.

• Full controller support, built with Steam Deck in mind.

• An original dark-fantasy orchestral soundtrack.

A note on Early Access

Deck Forge is in Early Access. The full loop is here and playable end to end — five classes, three acts, hundreds of cards, online co-op, Prestige. Early Access is about tuning the journey with your feedback: balancing card and class power, sharpening encounters, and adding more content on top of a solid foundation.

DeckDEX — Buy Low. Read the Room. Flip It.

You're not a chosen hero. You're not saving any kingdoms. You're a card dealer with a sharp eye and zero shame about reselling a bargain for triple. Welcome to DeckDEX — the trading-card flipping tycoon where the only stat that matters is your bank balance.

It's the stock market, except every share is a dragon. It's a yard sale, except the yard is an entire economy. There's no combat here — just the cold, beautiful thrill of buying a card for $4 and flipping it to some lovely sucker for $40.

💸 So… what do I actually do?

Hunt. Flip. Hoard. Repeat.

  • Spot the underpriced card on a live, shared marketplace full of rival dealers (and a few suspiciously efficient NPCs).

  • Buy it, hold it, relist it higher — and stare at price-history charts like a caffeinated day-trader.

  • Rip packs and pray to the rarity gods for a holo mythic (and not your ninth Rotting Ralph).

  • Complete collections, redeem finished sets for XP, and level your way to a cardboard empire.

🛒 The Marketplace

One board, every dealer. Filter by collection, rarity, finish, condition and price; snipe the lowest ask; or post a buy order and let the deal fill itself while you sleep. Bulk-buy, bulk-list, undercut your rivals — it's capitalism, but with gorgeous art.

🎴 Packs

Open packs with real odds and satisfying reveals, plus the full collector spread: rarities from Common to Mythic, Normal & Holo finishes, conditions from Damaged to Mint, and serial + print numbers for the true scarcity gremlins.

🔥 The Forge

Drowning in duplicates? Perfect. Throw 20 same-rarity cards into the Forge and smash them into one card of the next rarity up. It's recycling — for greed. You hand-pick exactly which dupes to sacrifice, so your best copies stay safe.

🗺️ Adventures

Send a party of your cards on timed expeditions to haul back cash and XP. They might return a little roughed up (a card can drop a condition — but it's never lost). Idle cards are lazy cards. Put them to work.

🏆 Tournaments & Guilds

Field your strongest roster in tournaments. Join or found a guild — chat, pool tributes, grind guild tasks, and climb the leaderboards. Friendship is magic. Market dominance is better.

💼 Build the Business

  • Work & passive income — money that rolls in while you scheme.

  • Staff — hire employees to restock and grade so you can think bigger.

  • Skills — a dealer skill tree: lower fees, more listing slots, burn cards for bonus XP, sharper appraisals and more.

  • Trust & Reputation — ship sales on time, earn ⭐ ratings, climb seller tiers for fatter margins. Flake on a buyer and you eat the refund.

🎡 …and the daily good stuff

Daily quests, login streaks, a spin-the-Wheel for cash, cards and skill points, Albums to show off your collection (with perks), a slick Dashboard that tells you exactly what to do next, light & dark themes, English & Polski, and cloud saves so your empire follows you everywhere.

🚧 Always cooking

DeckDEX is updated constantly — new cards, collections, features and balance tweaks drop on the regular. Got an idea? Vote in in-game polls and send feedback… a worrying amount of it actually ships.

Deckforce is an innovative roguelite deckbuilder that blends luck and strategy. Build your deck, manage bets, and dominate a constantly changing board.

Board Management and the Rule of 21

Carefully place cards on the grid to reach 21. Destroy cards with successful matches, trigger high-scoring combos, and protect your move space.

Deck Building and Special Powers

Buy packs from the market to add special cards to your inventory that fit your strategy. Control the board with cards like the black hole or area bomb.

Dynamic Challenges and Boss Fights

Adapt to changing rules like freezing or gravity in later stages. Adapt your strategy against powerful enemies like the "Magnet Boss" that disrupt the game flow.

Permanent Progression and Skill Tree

Unlock permanent upgrades with the experience points you gain. Gain an advantage in your next runs by boosting your starting money or base stats.

Your dog buried your homework somewhere underground

Swing a pickaxe at the ground under your house and see what is in it. Fill your bag, haul it up, sell it, buy something better, and go back down further than last time. Ore that was hard at 200 meters breaks on contact by 2,000. The number on your gold counter goes up and does not stop going up.

Reset, and keep what matters



When digging slows down, you prestige. Gold gone, gear gone, world reseeded. What stays is everything you actually built: 40+ talents across eight branches, every ore's mining level and the better prices that come with it, and anything you locked in at the Forge. Melt ore into rainbow bars, spend them, and that upgrade is maxed for the rest of the game, through every reset after it. Then there is Pressure, which is uncapped and makes ore more valuable the deeper you are mining.

Build it however you want



There is no correct route down. Put everything into the pickaxe and break rock by hand. Or ignore the pickaxe, wear the laser helmet, and let the beam eat whatever you have marked. Stack crit chance until every swing sets off a shockwave through the vein. Hunt chests and level all six tiers. The tree has 40+ nodes and you will not buy them all in one run.

27+ Unique Artifacts



Buried at depths that you will naturally discover while exploring the undergrounds. Each one shapes the game in an increasingly chaotic direction and makes your numbers go UP exponentially: candy that cracks the ore next to whatever you hit, gum that throws lightning down the vein, a swarm of nanobots that eats a pocket of rock on its own, a plumbline that drops you thousands of meters in one move. You keep them through every prestige.

The underground is not empty



Rewarding Ancient Caves. Mysterious Cathedrals in the deep rock. 10+ Fossils and 25+ Skins for you to find. Keys that open portals to 5+ other dimensions, each one a timed run for a haul you cannot get any other way. Sandstone deserts and permafrost fields with their own ore, a unique twist and their own ambient.

At 5,000 meters

The ground changes and your pickaxe stops working. There is a way through, and you have to make it yourself.

It has an ending

There is a bottom to this, and a reason you started digging. Finding it does not close the game. The world goes as deep as you have patience for, and people have been past 100,000 meters depth.

Good to know

  • Every meter is one you dug yourself. No offline progress.

  • Nine languages: English, Deutsch, 简体中文, Русский, Español, Português (BR), 日本語, Français, Polski.

  • Five save slots.

  • The dog thing is real and it does matter eventually.

Deep Frost is single-player social-deduction horror set in a failing Antarctic research station. A parasitic intelligence called the Thaw is copying the crew. Keep the outpost alive, build your case and decide how much trust you can afford.

Twelve researchers. Up to nine days. Something is wearing their faces.

INVESTIGATE THE STORY

Question researchers, inspect station records and compare accounts. Keep track of your sources in the Case File and your own field notebook. A contradiction gives you a lead; it does not prove someone is infected.

TAKE A SIDE AT THE ROUND TABLE

Accuse someone, defend a person you still suspect, or keep your theory to yourself. Your public statement and your ballot are separate decisions. Researchers can react to what they witnessed or learned about you.

KEEP THE STATION ALIVE

Failing systems threaten everyone. Investigate equipment problems and choose how to respond while the crew's suspicions grow. A successful repair can help the station without clearing anyone's name.

RETURN WITH DIFFERENT LOYALTIES

Each expedition draws twelve researchers from a cast of 48, with new hidden roles, events and relationships. In the full game, later expeditions deal you a hidden role: usually Crew, sometimes Thaw, secretly working to divert suspicion. Your first expedition, Daily stations and the demo always start you as Crew. Close reading, uncertainty and social choices drive the tension.

TRY THE FREE DEMO

Play the first three days, ending after Night 3. Day 1 teaches voting with a practice ballot. The full campaign continues into blood testing, later station threats and extraction. Reading and play time vary.

Developed and published by Aeon Games Canada. The character portraits and key art are by Krisztian Kiss, and the four story images are by Luis Martinez Vazquez. MOIRA’s voice is by Nicola Proctor, the early-game music is by SMTXGameDemos, and the late-game and night music is made in-house by Aeon Games Canada. In-game text includes machine-assisted translations.

about_html:
Climb out of the dark.

A thousand years ago, the world above ended. The few who survived fled underground and built a society in the dark. None of us has seen the surface. None of our parents did. None of theirs.

Then the deep shook. A roar from far above, deeper than any thunder. The ceilings we had trusted for a thousand years came down to find us. When the dust settled, there were six of us left.

The same shaking that dropped our city cracked the old gates open. For the first time in memory, the road up is there to take.

After every combat, your crew earns a choice: three cards appear, you pick one. Cards can unlock new combat abilities, layer passive buffs onto your party, or compound into synergies that define how the whole run plays out. No two climbs are alike. Every decision shapes the deck you carry up the climb.

Deep Rise is an underground colony survival game about six people trying to reach a light no one alive has seen. Every run is one push up through a maze of tunnels knotted by collapse and time. Find the keys, open the gate, and clear the zone. Die in the dark, and your colony is one fewer. Early Access launches with Zone 1, the first stretch of the climb.

Six survivors.

The last of us are not interchangeable. Two are strong, built to carry and to break. Two are clever, hard to corner, harder to catch. Two are more machine than flesh, fitted with worn plates and tireless hands.

  • The Breaker can carry the heaviest loads, and the heaviest hits. Strong arms, strong stomach, one direct answer to most problems.

  • The Welded is half human, half salvaged machine. Tireless, armored, and at home in the deepest dark, though they cannot carry a sleeping body home.

  • The Tinker is quick, sharp-minded, and the cleverest of us. Where the Breaker takes a hit and the Welded shrugs one off, the Tinker steps aside.

  • Draft one of three cards after every combat to build a unique run

The deep is not what it was.

The beasts in the maze were ordinary animals once, only rats and dogs and crawling things. Something took them. It bolted plates to their backs and bred them in the black, and fed them on whatever the dark provides. What came out is not what went in.

The Deep Ledger is the book dawnseekers carry into the maze and copy by hand as they go, every tunnel walked, every beast learned, every vein of salt found. What the Ledger holds, the colony keeps forever: every lore page copied by hand stays in the book.

But what a dawnseeker learns of the beasts lives only as long as they do. Die in the dark before reaching home, and the weaknesses they discovered die with them.

A colony to feed. A climb to plan.

Between every run, the outpost waits. Fungal farms and water reclaimers keep the colony alive. Workshops, smithies, and med bays let you outfit the next runner. Stockpile salt, stalkwood, palecap, and the dead circuitry pried from the walls. Spend it on weapons, armor, research, and the salt it takes to wake a sleeper.

Some of us were left in cold glass, sealed and breathing slow. With the right hands and enough bittersalt, we can wake them. Every sleeper you carry home is one more pair of hands for the climb.

The road up is a faith.

There is nothing left below us now. The deep gave us all it had. To stay is to starve in the black. So we climb, toward a light the old stories promised and no living person has ever seen.

Up is not a direction to us anymore. It is the only one we have left.

Intense Space Combat:

Eliminate enemies, collect ore, upgrade a variety of incredible weapons and gear, and survive in this alien universe.

Embark with up to 6 players on an underwater adventure to uncover treasures, shipwrecks, resources, or forgotten creatures. You’ll also almost certainly find death.

Print your gear, assign roles, and craft a careful strategy. Or just charge in headfirst—whatever floats your submarine.

Learn from failed expeditions.
And loot their equipment, it could prove useful.

Your teammates have gone silent, and a menacing shadow looms. Muster all your courage and throw it as a distraction while you make a break for it.

If you’re still alive, dive back in deeper.

A mining pod, a fuel gauge, and a lot of rock

You drill for REGOLITH Deep Extraction. The pod flies on thrusters and chews through any rock you point it at. Fuel burns the whole time you are below the surface, so every descent ends with the same question: one more vein, or turn back now.

Sell what you bring up. Buy a longer drill, a bigger tank, a thicker hull. Go deeper.

The descent is the game

Every metre of strata is destructible and every metre costs you. Fuel burns the whole time you're below the surface line. Cargo weight fights your thrusters. Undermine a boulder and it drops on you, and the further it falls the more it hurts. Bite into a gas pocket and it goes up - along with every pocket touching it.

Plain dirt is not always plain dirt. Buried caches hide a hidden vein, a fuel gush, a relic - or a lava seep and a very short trip home.

Read the rock

Living Strata formations are seeded into the ordinary geology, each with a rule you can learn. Relieve fractured stress nodes, vent pressurised seams, quench thermal cores, brace brittle shelves. Work one cleanly and it pays a mastery bonus on top of the ore. Rush it and the formation turns on you.

Five contracts and an open one

  • Certification - Luna Proving Grounds. Gentle rock, first descent.

  • The Mars Contract - Outpost Karga. A classic run, and a lost beacon to recover.

  • Ember Harvest - Io. Lava everywhere, thermal cores to extract.

  • The Cold Archive - Callisto. Slow ice drilling, gas pockets, forward bases.

  • Site Omega - The Rift. Bedrock maze, every hazard, and the STRATA-9 Guardian.

  • Open Contract - Mars Deep. No quotas. Just the depth meter. Open from the start.

The story arrives over the radio while you work — dispatch, the other drillers, and an abandoned terraformer AI that has been alone for a very long time.

Wake it, or feed it

Each site's guardian sleeps in its own chamber until the final mission opens. Put a shot into it and fight - volleys, dashes, slam shockwaves, and collapsing ceilings. Or haul down the offering it wants and feed the sleeping machine instead.

Set your own pressure

Every contract deploys at Peaceful, Standard, Hard or Brutal. Harder means worse odds, more seismic storms and meaner caches - and more XP.

## BUILD YOUR DEFENDERS

Defense Of Legends combines classic tower defense strategy with character builds and item customization.

Your defenses aren't ordinary towers — they're heroes.

Deploy your characters, upgrade their abilities, equip them with powerful items, and create builds capable of stopping increasingly dangerous enemy waves.

## CREATE YOUR OWN BUILDS

Every character can become stronger through the items you give them.

Instead of simply increasing damage, experiment with different stats, effects, and item combinations to specialize your heroes for different situations.

Build around Physical Damage, Magic Damage, Critical Strikes, Attack Speed, elemental effects, survivability, and more.

Find unexpected synergies and turn an ordinary defender into the centerpiece of your strategy.

## CHOOSE THE RIGHT HEROES

Different heroes bring different strengths to your defense.

Combine their abilities and builds to create a team capable of dealing with both ground and flying enemies.

A build that destroys one wave may struggle against the next, so adapting your strategy is just as important as raw power.

## EXPERIMENT WITH ITEMS

Items are a core part of Defense Of Legends.

Equip your heroes with weapons, magical artifacts, defensive equipment, and specialized items that can dramatically change how they perform.

Experiment. Combine effects. Find your favorite builds.

And sometimes, create something completely overpowered.

Position your heroes, improve your builds, and prepare your defenses before your enemies break through.

How far can your strategy take you?
